gold_tool: gopls v0.23.0 rename -w of echo.HTTPStatusCoder.StatusCode, then of each concrete StatusCode method that satisfies the interface only dynamically (found with a go/types Implements scan over all packages incl. tests: ProblemError, httpError, customError, apiError); go1.26.3 GOTOOLCHAIN=local; gofmt on changed files
instruction: The method `StatusCode()` on the `echo.HTTPStatusCoder` interface (httperror.go) has the same name as the package-level `echo.StatusCode(err)` helper and the `StatusCode` field of `http.Response`, which makes the code hard to read. Rename the interface method `HTTPStatusCoder.StatusCode` to `HTTPStatus`. The rename must cover the interface declaration, every error type that implements the interface (including ones in tests), and every call of the method, including tests. Do not rename the package-level `StatusCode` function, `http.Response.StatusCode`, or any other unrelated `StatusCode` identifier. Behavior must not change: the project must still build and its tests must pass.
notes: gopls alone renamed only the interface and HTTPError.StatusCode (the one statically converted to the interface); ProblemError, httpError and two test error types satisfy HTTPStatusCoder only through errors.As, so gopls left them. They were renamed with additional gopls calls after a go/types implements scan. A missed dynamic implementer still compiles.
